instruction: You have my go-ahead to do the seven editing tasks 'as is'. For the optional changes, do the 'One small worked succession example', don't bother with the holiday one. Let's work on the three copy decisions now.
scope: Preserve original canonical gardening records and frozen approved references
Preserve body text size, two-page crop spreads and current folios
Prepare focused highlighted proofs in both units
New proofs remain for review; this receipt is approval of the editing brief, not self-approval of its eventual results
